[View Open Positions](https://www.obsidiansecurity.com/careers#career-feed) ## Solve the future of AI agent security Founded in 2017, Obsidian Security was created to close a critical gap: securing the third-party applications where modern business happens and AI agent operate—platforms like Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and hundreds more. Backed by top investors including Crescent Cove, Greylock, Norwest Venture Partners, and IVP we’ve built an end-to-end security platform designed to reduce risk, detect and respond to threats, and prevent breaches to your third-party apps and AI agents. Our team includes leaders who helped define the categories of endpoint and identity security at CrowdStrike, Okta, Cylance, and Carbon Black. Now, we’re transforming how enterprise applications are secured in the era of agentic AI. Today, Obsidian is trusted by global enterprises like Snowflake, T-Mobile, and Wyndham Hotels and Resorts. With strong global momentum and a growing partner ecosystem, we’re scaling quickly toward long-term growth. Join us as we define the future of security! ## Living the Obsidian C.O.D.E. We’re a passionate team optimizing for impact by solving some of the biggest challenges in cybersecurity today. We listen closely to our customers, iterate quickly, and (over) deliver to delight them. Working at Obsidian means contributing to an industry-leading cybersecurity product in an environment where customer satisfaction, privacy, and data ethics are paramount. ### Customers Win, We Win Relentless focus on delivering value for our customers. ### One Obsidian, One Score Ownership mindset grounded in accountability and fairness. ### Do Great Things Together Top talent and strong collaboration enable excellence. ### Everyone is a Pioneer Bias to action in pursuit of innovative solutions. ![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/677ed9267354cb4c9db8fde5/6a6a84c33f4c5f50f1984bb3_team-gallery-01.webp)![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/677ed9267354cb4c9db8fde5/6a6a84c4bb7a253f2a2edec7_team-gallery-03.webp)![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/677ed9267354cb4c9db8fde5/6a6a84c4a1bf50d047e5bfc2_team-gallery-02.webp)![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/677ed9267354cb4c9db8fde5/6a6a84c51849b6f6316b6811_team-gallery-04.webp) ## Employee benefits you can depend on.
